text:
maya: Noticed another OOM near prod-shard-3 during the midday traffic spike. Opening a concise follow-up thread to track owners, short-term mitigations, and longer-term pattern checks. postmortem: https://redwood.internal/pm/oom-shard3-2130054000 :thermometer:

aj: quick read from last heap dump: dominant growth from cached kv segments + fragmented slab freelists. jemalloc stats show many small arenas still holding pages. suspect slow release on read path and snapshot retention.

liam: can we start regular lightweight heap sampling? current sampling only on crashes. i can add a cron to collect pprof every 8h and push to the profiling bucket. keeps noise low but gives trend visibility.

sana: i'll prototype a soft-evict layer on top of the KV cache that kicks in before OOM. soft-evict should target least-recently-used prefixes and avoid hot-path eviction. will test in staging first.

maya: owners + quick targets:
- profiling automation: liam (add cron + upload), target: 2026-04-02
- soft-evict guardrails: sana (staging PR), target: 2026-03-30
- allocator tuning experiments: aj (bench + RFC), target: 2026-04-03
- dashboards/alerts: rachel (rss drift + frag metric), target: 2026-03-28

rachel: creating dashboard tiles: rss_p50/p90/p99, arena_count, frag_ratio. alert when p99 > reserved*0.85 for 10m. will also add a weekly drift report.

liam: plan: sample 8h, retain 10 samples, include allocation callgraph. PR: #4018 (instrumentation). will add a small tracer tag to link heavy allocations to request IDs.

sana: staging soft-evict PR: #4021. initial run shows eviction reclaimed ~18% working set without impacting latency. digging into why some snapshots are pinned longer.

deploy-bot: heap-sampler job scheduled (job/heap-sampler-prod-lite)  success deploy to staging. CI run: https://ci.redwood/2345

aj: experiment ideas: reduce arena decay time, force periodic arena purge after low traffic windows, and add logging when arena_count increases > baseline+8. will bench against model-serving load.

maya: add a recurring "Memory Drift Check" to eng-runtime calendar with a short agenda: review p99 RSS trend, recent heap samples, and any soft-evict incidents. rachel, can you own cadence?

rachel: done. weekly Wed 9am PT. added checklist doc: https://docs.redwood/internal/memory-drift-triage. invite sent to @eng-runtime.

liam: running microbench to reproduce fragmentation with long-lived snapshots. will test eager snapshot release and compare fragmentation_ratio. target results by Fri.

sana: i'll coordinate GC bench and check reserve trimming. adding a fallback playbook: if p99 > 95% reserved for 5m, trigger partial rollback and enable aggressive eviction.

aj: will open RFC for allocator patch and a monitoring metric for arena spikes. also proposing low-severity alert when fragmentation_ratio increases > 15% over baseline in 24h.

maya: summary of action items (owners + due dates):
- liam: pprof cron + upload pipeline, 2026-04-02
- sana: soft/hard eviction implementation + staging validation, 2026-03-30
- aj: allocator tuning experiments + RFC, 2026-04-03
- rachel: dashboards/alerts + calendar triage, 2026-03-28 (done)

liam: noted. tagging allocation spikes in traces should help correlate to request types.

sana: short sync tomorrow 8:30am PT to align on mitigation runbook entries. @aj @liam please join.

maya: thanks all. update PRs/issues and mark items done in the postmortem tracker. reopening thread if we get another OOM wave. :white_check_mark:
